member: Farah — Post-Harvest and Cooperative Operations Specialist
message:
Surya, Lena, daily warm intake must stay small using the stackable vented crates (C7). Plain words, a small warm batch fits the sun field while a full warm tonne does not, so I cap intake at one-fifth of the store per day and I recompute because the daily batch electric was missing. Numbers are 200 kg per day, about 12 crates at 15 to 20 kg, needing 2.00 kWh batch electric from the daily batch electric for 200 kg (E55) derived from 25.0 kilowatt hour per tonne from the steady cooling load and pull-down for 1 tonne box (E24), plus 3.60 kWh per day holding from the daily electric kWh from 150 W continuous (E52), totalling 5.60 kWh per day below 8.10 kWh per day from the daily PV yield from 2.4 kWp (E54), sane against half a household day.

Kofi, the racks still fit people and crates using the two side racks with centre aisle (C8). Plain words, low side shelves leave a walkway with air gaps for cold air and mopping. Numbers are 600 by 400 mm crates from the Best Folding Vented 600x400 Plastic Crates (E26), about 60 crates stacked 3 high with 100 mm gaps and 900 mm door from the Interior plan and section (E36), sane against a bucket of water per lift and a household doorway. Not ready, because chiller batch watts with Lena and rack fixings with Kofi are still open.
